description.value: Sushi Lovers is a sushi and sashimi restaurant in Richmond's Blundell Road area, offering a menu that includes party trays and more. The business is affiliated with a 'Seafood Group' that includes Sylvia's Seafood and Meat Lovers, suggesting a broader seafood operation. Cyclists passing through Richmond's flat, bikeable streets will find this a convenient stop for Japanese fare.

No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist amenities, so those remain null.
